headlines.title: Elizabeth Warren Wants to Break Up UnitedHealth, and One Day Later a Nonprofit Called It Undervalued
headlines.summary: Elizabeth Warren is pushing to dismantle UnitedHealth Group just as a nonprofit investor education group moves in the opposite direction, naming the embattled insurer its top undervalued pick for early 2027. The timing raises a question every UNH shareholder needs to answer.

headlines.title: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Draws ETF Buying As Margin Recovery Fuels Undervalued Debate
headlines.summary: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) is drawing attention after a four day stretch of net ETF buying, capped by US$35.0 million of purchases on October 29, concentrated in large health care and blue chip funds. Recent headlines around UnitedHealth Group range from solid third quarter results to AI driven criticism of insurer pricing, while policy changes such as easing prior authorizations for pediatric care highlight shifting risk and regulatory attention.

headlines.title: BetterInvesting™ Magazine Update on Amazon.com and UnitedHealth Group
headlines.summary: The Editorial Advisory and Securities Review Committee of BetterInvesting Magazine today announced Amazon.com (NASDAQ: AMZN) as its "Stock to Study" and UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) as its "Undervalued Stock" in the January February 2027 issue for investors' informational and educational use.

headlines.title: Will UNH's Optum Insight Spending Translate Into Profit Growth?
headlines.summary: UnitedHealth is scaling AI solutions across Optum Insight to boost efficiency, improve claims processing and drive long-term growth despite rising costs.

headlines.title: UnitedHealth (UNH) Sees $35.0 Million in Net ETF Buying on Oct. 29
headlines.summary: ETFs bought $35.0 million of UnitedHealth shares on Thursday, with 41 funds buying and 19 selling.

description: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated operates as a health care company in the United States and internationally. It operates through four segments: Optum Health, Optum Insight, Optum Rx; and UnitedHealthcare. The Optum Health segment provides care delivery, care management, wellness and consumer engagement, and health financial services with patients, consumers, care delivery systems, providers, employers, payers, and public-sector entities. The Optum Insight segment offers software and information products, advisory consulting arrangements, and managed services outsourcing contracts to hospital systems, physicians, health plans, public entities, life sciences companies and other organizations. The Optum Rx segment provides pharmacy care services and programs, including retail network contracting, home delivery, specialty and community health pharmacy services, infusion, and purchasing and clinical capabilities, as well as develops programs in the areas of step therapy, formulary management, drug adherence, and disease and drug therapy management. The UnitedHealthcare segment offers consumer-oriented health benefit plans and services for national employers, public sector employers, mid-sized employers, small businesses, and individuals; Medicaid plans, including Temporary Assistance to Needy Families; Children's Health Insurance Programs; Dual SNPs; Long-Term Services and Supports; Aged, Blind and Disabled; and other federal, state, and community health care programs. and health care benefits products and services to state programs caring for the economically disadvantaged, medically underserved, and those without the benefit of employer-funded health care coverage. UnitedHealth Group Incorporated was founded in 1974 and is based in Eden Prairie, Minnesota.
